faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the PGT (Sociology) post?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the PGT (Sociology) position at PM SHRI Kendriya Vidyalaya Dehradun is 16th September 2026. Ensure your application is submitted well before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for the PGT (Sociology) recruitment at PM SHRI Kendriya Vidyalaya Dehradun primarily involves an interview. Candidates who are shortlisted based on their applications will be called for an interview.

faq.question: Q3. What is the mode of application for this job?
faq.answer: The application process for the PGT (Sociology) post is entirely online. Candidates are required to register and submit their applications through the designated SAMVIDA SATHI portal.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee mentioned for this post?
faq.answer: As per the available information, no specific application fee has been mentioned in the official notification for the PGT (Sociology) recruitment. Candidates should verify this on the official portal.

faq.question: Q5. What is the job type for the PGT (Sociology) position?
faq.answer: The PGT (Sociology) position at PM SHRI Kendriya Vidyalaya Dehradun is a contractual role, meaning the appointment will be on a contract basis for the specified academic session.

faq.question: Q6. Where is PM SHRI Kendriya Vidyalaya Dehradun located?
faq.answer: PM SHRI Kendriya Vidyalaya Dehradun is located in Dehradun, Uttarakhand, with the pincode 248146. The recruitment is specifically for the ITBP campus.
